# Scalar and aggregate functions of DuckDB 1.5.6 (+ json), reviewed for the access
# policy (#49, #105): none of them reads a table, the catalog, statistics, settings
# or SQL text outside the policy's views — except the ones in
# policy::DENIED_FUNCTIONS, which a dashboard may not call. tests/policy_duckdb.rs
# fails when DuckDB has a function that is not listed here: review it, deny it if
# needed, then add it.
